title: Generic Resolved-Column Explicit Effective-Forcing Executor Structural Candidate
goal: Introduce only the generic execution seam required by F-MR37: registry-facing callers resolve handles, while one shared transaction/backend executor consumes one resolved parameter object, one explicit effective forcing object and the selected committed state. Preserve every currently admitted execution path; do not activate parallel DIVDRA.

semantic_candidate.registry_wrapper: existing fmr_execute_serialized_physical_column remains source compatible and resolves forcing_handle from forcing_registry
semantic_candidate.new_seam: new public worker-oriented procedure accepts one explicit fmr_b110_physical_forcing_t after registry resolution
semantic_candidate.shared_executor: existing checkpoint -> trial -> mass-completeness -> candidate -> commit/discard path is factored once and receives resolved template/parameter/forcing/state inputs

required_proofs: existing registry-facing serialized per-column executor remains behavior-compatible
new explicit-forcing seam is behavior-identical when passed the canonical selected forcing object
parallel V1 still routes through the unchanged registry-facing wrapper and remains behavior-compatible
canonically admitted serialized active DIVDRA remains behavior-compatible
new seam takes effective forcing intent(in) and does not own or persist it
no second transaction path or second mass booking is introduced
all predictable routing failures occur before physical trial
all 30 SWAP architecture invariants are explicitly audited
qualification_handoff: independent F-VQ53 if still free after owner closeout
